title: Frontiers: How Support for Black Lives Matter Impacts Consumer Responses on Social Media
eligible_reason: Main design (Tables 4-5) is a within-brand cross-platform DiD aligned in event time. treat = Instagram account (vs. the brand's other platform), after = weeks after the brand's BLM support, and periods are relative weeks -7..7 (period1-period14), with brand x after and brand x treat FE. Every treated unit switches at event week 0, so there is one cohort in the estimating time index and no calendar-time FE. All columns add time-varying content controls (avgsumPosts, avgsumAt, avgsumAt2, LDA/LSTM post scores). Table 3 (notebook) regresses daily outcomes on a non-absorbing daily BLM_Post indicator (brand + source:date FE) plus lags and Participants interactions.
design_notes: Tables.do: reg following period* interaction <content controls> avgsumPosts avgsumAt avgsumAt2 i.bd##after i.bd##treat (final_noise.dta: 96 brands x 2 platforms x 14 event weeks = 2,688 rows). Column 3 uses final_2019_noise.dta (2020 vs 2019 placebo-year comparison); column 4 uses final_nonParticipant_noise.dta, which is not shipped. Table 5 adds moderator x DID interactions. table3_replication_20pct_sample.ipynb (R lfe) reads table3_data_rep_sample.csv, which is not shipped; the notebook embeds output from the 20% sample: felm(y ~ BLM_Post | brand + source:date | 0 | brand+date).
n_eligible_specs_note: One event-time cohort, time-varying controls in every column, and a non-absorbing daily indicator in Table 3.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Brands are aligned at their own support week, so all treated units share event week 0. Calendar dates are not in the data.

specs.controls: meansumSs_lda sdsumSs_lda meansumPromo_lda avgsumPosts avgsumAt avgsumAt2 (time-varying)
specs.notes: Excluded: single event-time cohort with no calendar time FE, time-varying controls, noised data.

data_files_note: readme.txt: brand identities removed, 'random noise' added to key variables such as following and liking, and Table 3 uses a 20% random sample of brands. final_nonParticipant_noise.dta and table3_data_rep_sample.csv are referenced but not shipped.
software_notes: Stata for Tables 4-5; R (lfe) Jupyter notebook for Table 3.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Variable labels inspected in the shipped .dta files: period1-14 = wk -7..7 relative week; interaction labelled 'DID (BLM_Treatment *After)'; treat labelled 'Treatment (Instagram)'.
